jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Marketing Specialist is responsible for supporting the marketing, branding, communication, and outreach efforts of Health Care Partners of South Carolina. This position develops and promotes patient-focused outreach initiatives that increase awareness of organizational services, strengthen community engagement, support internal and external events, and enhance the visibility of Health Care Partners throughout the communities served.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

* Assists with the development and implementation of marketing campaigns that support organizational goals, patient engagement, and service growth.

* Creates and maintains marketing materials, brochures, flyers, presentations, newsletters, and promotional content.

* Assists with website content updates and digital communication initiatives.

* Supports social media initiatives and content development across organizational platforms.

* Ensures consistency of organizational branding and marketing messages.

* Develops outreach materials and campaigns that increase awareness of Health Care Partners services, programs, providers, and community resources.

* Supports marketing efforts aimed at increasing patient engagement and attracting new patients within the communities served.

* Assists with the planning, promotion, and coordination of internal Health Care Partners events, employee engagement activities, recognition programs, and organizational celebrations.

* Assists with the planning, promotion, and coordination of community outreach events, health fairs, wellness initiatives, partner events, and public-facing activities.

* Serves as a marketing liaison for organizational and community events to ensure appropriate branding, promotion, and community awareness.

* Tracks marketing projects and assists with measuring campaign effectiveness and community impact.

* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Education & Experience**
==========================

* Bachelor degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Journalism, Graphic Design, Healthcare Administration, Public Relations, or a related field preferred.

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in marketing, communications, branding, digital media, event planning, public outreach, or a related field preferred.

* Experience within healthcare, FQHCs, nonprofit organizations, or public health organizations preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Knowledge of marketing, branding, communications, and community outreach principles.

* Strong written, verbal, and creative communication skills.

* Strong organizational, project management, and event-planning skills.

* Ability to develop patient-focused outreach campaigns and educational materials.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar marketing platforms preferred.

* Ability to maintain brand consistency across marketing materials and communications.

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and travel as required.

* Ability to attend and support internal and external events.

* Ability to lift and transport materials up to 25 pounds.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job overview:**

We are looking for a highly organized and strategic Content Marketing Manager to lead our B2B content programs and customer story program in North America.

This role will act as the project manager, editor, and reviewer for all written content—customer stories, blog articles, bylines, and other content—ensuring each deliverable aligns with brand standards, supports campaign objectives, and drives measurable performance. It will entail some writing opportunities as well, mainly for short form copy, such as digital ads and emails.

The ideal candidate combines strong writing, editorial judgment, and creativity with project management skills. The candidate can manage multiple projects, collaborate well with other team members, and direct a team of freelance writers to execute on multiple projects that support the goals of the North America Marketing Team.

**Your day at a glance:**

* Manage a team of freelance writers, agency partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure high value content projects are completed on time. Examples include, but are not limited to:
* + Customer stories – both written and video
  + Blog articles
  + Ebooks and long-form assets
* Write short-form copy for small projects, include digital ads and emails
* Review and edit content to ensure alignment with brand voice, messaging, and quality standards
* Review content briefs and make suggestions for content enhancements
* Manage the North America Customer Story program – both written and video
* + Promote the customer story program to internal team and potential customers
  + Schedule and direct customer interviews
  + Manage follow-up reviews, and final approvals
* Continuously analyze content performance and recommend improvements
* Work with internal team members to suggest content additions or improvements to enhance campaign performance.
* Manage and prioritize work based on corporate and team objectives.
* Monitor and report on key metrics such as number of customer stories, engagement, and traffic

**What makes you a great fit:**

* 3–7+ years of experience in **content marketing or editorial management**
* Proven experience managing **multiple content formats** (case studies, blogs, whitepapers/ebooks, bylines)
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle overlapping deadlines and stakeholders
* Experience managing **freelance writers or agency partners**
* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities
* Working knowledge of **SEO and content performance optimization**
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Experience using a project management platform
* Candidate must be located anywhere in the East or Central USA

**Let’s talk perks!**

* Attractive compensation package with 401K match
* Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule

We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!

*Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.*

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing and Content
jobs.description:
**About Mid Hudson Energy Transition**

Mid-Hudson Energy Transition, Inc. (MHET) is a not-for-profit community-based organization that empowers municipalities, their residents, and businesses to own and share renewable energy, create healthier buildings, and join in community wealth-building to strengthen the resilience of the Hudson Valley in the face of climate change. We engage and build on the active involvement of communities, with particular emphasis on low-income and communities of color that are being harmed first and worst by climate change.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing and Content Manager shapes how MHET looks, sounds, and shows up for community members, funders, partners, and the public. This person owns MHET's brand and the day-to-day work of telling our story: social media, the website, the monthly newsletter, graphic design, event promotion, program recruitment campaigns, and energy education materials that help residents understand their homes, their bills, and their energy choices.

They work closely with program staff to turn real outcomes and real people's stories into materials that are clear, accessible, and true to the communities we serve. They also help our team share what MHET has learned with the wider field – producing the annual impact report, social media videos, presentations, and toolkits that show how a community-rooted model for energy justice actually works. This is a hands-on, high-output role for a strong designer and writer who likes seeing their work out in the world, someone equally comfortable designing a flyer, drafting a newsletter, and planning a campaign calendar.

**Reports To**

* Executive Director

**Our Programs**

**Outreach & Education (O&E):** Outreach is the cornerstone of all that we do. At its core, MHET is a community-based organization, formed in service to the Kingston community and the marginalized people who have been overburdened by environmental hazards here. Through our O&E program, we listen to the community’s needs, connect people to our programs, revise or co-create new programs in partnership with our Community Council, and create inclusive and accessible ways to educate our community on energy systems, solutions, and justice.

**The HELP Fund:** The HELP Fund is the Hudson Valley’s first green community investment fund. It mobilizes local capital to accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels while expanding access to safe, affordable, and energy-efficient housing for low- and moderate-income households. By offering a range of investment opportunities to both accredited and non-accredited investors, the Fund enables community members to invest directly in solutions that strengthen local resilience, reduce energy burden, and build long-term community wealth.

**The Home Energy Loan Program (HELP):** HELP provides 2% interest loans that help residents finance home energy upgrades that boost safety, health, energy efficiency, and climate resilience. Beyond financing, HELP offers wraparound project management support and includes incentives designed to empower borrowers, build wealth, enhance financial literacy, and support recovery from financial setbacks. This program is here to make energy improvements more accessible, impactful, and supportive of long-term financial wellbeing.

**Home Upgrade Grants (HUG):** HUG provides holistic project management to low-income homeowners for home improvements related to health, safety, energy efficiency and electrification. Through wrap-around technical and financing support – including grantmaking – and in collaboration with contractors and government agencies, HUG empowers residents to live in safe, healthy, efficient, and affordable homes, ready for electrification and resilient to climate emergencies.

**Energy Innovation (EI):** Energy Innovation encompasses a portfolio of projects with the central goal of empowering marginalized communities to own and share renewable energy; as such, it includes community solar (discounts on electricity bills through shared solar projects), renewable energy project development, and community energy planning. Currently, the EI team has been exploring a municipal thermal energy network, community-owned solar project, and an agrivoltaics pilot (agricultural farms paired with solar generation). Community ownership models, income generation for frontline communities, and local grid resilience are core considerations.

**Responsibilities**

*Program Materials & Design (30%)*

* Co-develop an annual marketing calendar with program and leadership staff that sets a strategic cadence of campaigns, timed to meet recruitment, outreach, and fundraising goals.
* Design visual assets for MHET's marketing, events, and fundraising – including social graphics, event flyers, presentations, and sponsor recognition materials – using tools such as Canva and Adobe.
* Design and write program materials and energy education resources – workshop slides, handouts, FAQs, explainers, infographics, talking points, and short videos – that help residents understand MHET's programs, energy systems, utility bills, home upgrades, and energy justice, with subject-matter support from program staff.
* Translate technical and policy topics (e.g., heat pumps, weatherization, community solar, thermal energy networks) into plain-language, visually clear materials.
* Ensure all materials are culturally responsive, accessible, and reflective of the communities MHET serves, and advance language justice by making all materials available in plain language and in English and Spanish, in coordination with MHET’s in-house translation support.
* Test materials with community members and the Community Council, and revise based on what people find useful and clear.

*Channel Management (30%)*

* Lead MHET's social media presence across platforms: developing content calendars, creating and scheduling posts, monitoring engagement, and growing audience, including building MHET's video presence

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
RareCyte is a precision biology company developing innovative technologies and products for spatial proteomics and liquid biopsy. Our platforms are used by leading therapeutic companies and research institutions worldwide to advance translational and clinical research programs. The company's Orion™ spatial proteomics platform uses novel single-round technology to deliver quantitative, high-plex spatial biomarker data with the throughput and reproducibility required to support the development of precision therapeutics. The CyteFinder®, AccuCyte®, and RarePlex® products enable class leading rare cell detection for liquid biopsy.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to develop compelling, scientifically credible content and execute digital marketing campaigns that build brand awareness, engage target audiences, and drive demand for our technologies and services. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer with a strong scientific background and experience marketing to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic clinical research audiences. This individual will independently manage content development from research and subject matter expert interviews through writing, editing, publication, and optimization with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, differentiated content across digital marketing channels.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Content Development**

* Research, write, and edit high-quality scientific and commercial content, including blogs, application notes, white papers, case studies, website copy, and sales enablement materials
* Translate complex scientific information into compelling, application-focused messaging for biopharma and life sciences research audiences
* Interview scientists, customers, and internal subject matter experts to develop accurate, differentiated content while maintaining consistent messaging and brand voice
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve content production efficiency while maintaining scientific and editorial quality

  

**Digital Marketing and Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns, including email, social media, landing pages, webinars, and digital advertising
* Write, schedule, and publish engaging content across email, social media, and other digital marketing channels
* Develop audience-specific content to support customer engagement throughout the buying journey and optimize website and campaign content for search visibility, engagement, and lead generation
* Repurpose scientific content across multiple formats and channels to maximize reach and impact

  

**Scientific Thought Leadership**

* Develop thought leadership and educational content addressing trends in spatial biology, precision oncology, biomarker development, and therapeutic research
* Collaborate with scientific experts, customers, and external partners to communicate research applications and technology advances
* Support scientific presentations, conference abstracts, webinars, and media-related content

  

**Content Planning and Optimization**

* Maintain and execute an editorial calendar aligned with marketing priorities and commercial campaigns

* Apply SEO and emerging AI-search optimization best practices to improve content discoverability
* Monitor content performance and recommend improvements based on engagement, traffic, and lead-generation metrics
* Manage multiple content projects independently while meeting deadlines and maintaining high editorial standards

### **Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline
* 5-10 years of experience in scientific content marketing and communications
* Exceptional scientific writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical subjects clearly and persuasively
* Experience independently developing scientific and commercial marketing content for biopharma and academic clinical research audiences including websites, blogs, email campaigns, and social media
* Working knowledge of SEO, digital marketing, and content performance analytics
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities independently
* Proficiency with AI-assisted content development tools
* Portfolio of personally authored scientific and marketing content

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience marketing life sciences research instrument platforms and lab services
* Familiarity with spatial biology market
* Graduate degree in life science discipline
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, content management, and anlytics platforms

### **Compensation**

Base Salary Range: $130,000 - $160,000 (annualized)

  

* Determining a base salary will be based on several factors which include skill set, level of education, experience and qualifications, as well as RareCyte internal equity. Some roles may also qualify for additional compensation such as bonus, commission, stock options and travel allowance.

Under the general direction of the Communications and Engagement Manager or Supervisor, the position assists in implementing the City of Fruita’s communications, engagement, outreach and marketing strategy through creative content development, storytelling, digital marketing, and community-focused communications. The position will work across a wide range of topics and audiences and will lead the development and distribution of content for the city’s various communication networks, including tourism marketing GoFruita as a destination to visitors, telling the stories behind the people, projects, and services of City departments, and advertising the city’s various programs with emphasis on recreation programs, community initiatives and special events.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Assists in planning and executing the City’s overall communications and marketing strategy, translating broader goals into creative campaigns, stories, digital content, advertising, and other public-facing communications.

· Develops, writes, and manages engaging content across City of Fruita, GoFruita tourism, Parks and Recreation, and other City programs. Creates content for social media, newsletters, websites, print publications, and other communication channels, including photography, video, graphics, advertisements, signage, brochures, and other marketing materials, while maintaining established brand standards.

· Creates content and disseminates stories about City services, employees, projects, community members, local businesses, recreation, tourism, and special events.

· Collaborates with employees across City departments to identify communications needs and ways to better connect City programs and services with residents and visitors. Translates technical or complex information into clear, approachable public-facing content.

· Supports and assists in executing marketing campaigns for City programs, recreation offerings, tourism initiatives, and special events, including organic social media, email marketing, radio appearances, print materials, and other promotional efforts.

· Supports GoFruita tourism marketing by creating content such as written materials, video, and photos that promotes Fruita as a destination while highlighting the community, local businesses, outdoor recreation, culture, events, and visitor experiences.

· Supports City special events through pre-event promotion, on-site content capture, social media coverage, photography and video, and post-event storytelling.

· Regularly maintains and updates content across City and program websites, portals, and digital platforms. collaborate with City staff to create and maintain web content on the City’s public and employee websites to help ensure information is accurate, timely, accessible, and consistent with established standards. Conduct quality assurance checks and content audits to verify accuracy, standardization, functionality, and compliance with ADA accessibility; troubleshoot website issues; test website appearance and functionality.

· Plans and manages paid advertising campaigns using platforms such as Meta and monitors basic performance data across advertising, social media, email, and web channels to help improve future campaigns.

· Maintains organized photo, video, graphic, and other digital asset libraries and stays current on social media trends, content creation tools, digital marketing practices, and emerging communication platforms.

· Assists with other communications, marketing, tourism, and community engagement projects as assigned.

· Coordinate and participate in public meetings and open house programs to promote City services and to provide a better understanding of the organization; provide public education and information; create and implement programs, citizen outreach activities and special events; work with City staff across multiple departments to identify and develop solutions for engagement needs.

· Monitor, interact, and respond to citizen interactions on the City’s website and social media channels to cultivate engagement;

· Review analytics across all social, print, and broadcast media and translate data into recommended plans to revise City strategic communications plans; lead survey initiatives and analyze public opinion; implement actionable insights. Gather information and prepare a variety of reports and records; maintain logs and records of activities and events.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

This position has no supervisory responsibilities

**Education, Experience and Certifications.** Minimum requirements include:

Ø Associate degree in Marketing Communications, Travel and Tourism Management, Communication, Public Relations, Brand Communication, Digital Marketing and Social

Media or related field from an accredited college or university.

Ø Two years of professional experience in communications, marketing, social media, content creation, public relations, tourism marketing, or a related field preferred.

Ø Other combinations of experience and education that meet the minimum requirements may be substituted.

Ø Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid Colorado driver's license.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

**Knowledge of:**

Ø Modern practices, procedures, strategies and techniques of communications, marketing, branding, media relations, governmental relations, and community/public relations .

Ø Effective communication and public speaking techniques.

Ø English usage, spelling, grammar and punctuation.

Ø Principles and practices of communicating and coordinating programs and initiatives.

Ø Principles and applications of graphic design and layout.

Ø Modern practices, procedures, strategies and techniques of communications, marketing, branding, media relations, governmental relations, and community/public relations.

jobs.title: Marketing Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
**Our Story:**

Story Cannabis was built by misfits on a mission — people bold enough to shift the cannabis narrative and create something better. Founded in 2021 by industry veterans, Story is a vertically integrated company headquartered in Phoenix, operating across Arizona, Maryland, Ohio, and Louisiana, and we're just getting started.

Our vision is to bring hope, happiness, and healing to the world through cannabis, and we're doing it one state, one store, and one customer at a time.

Leadership defines how we show up. Data drives how we grow. Gratitude keeps us grounded. Unity fuels our momentum. And growth, in every sense, inspires everything we do.

If you're ready to challenge what's expected and shape the future of cannabis, your next chapter starts with Story.

**Overview:**

The Marketing Communications Specialist manages Story Cannabis's day-to-day email, SMS and social media communications strategy and execution across retail (B2C) and wholesale (B2B) channels in all markets. The Specialist independently evaluates channel performance, audience needs, campaign objectives and established regulatory requirements to determine communication approaches, timing, segmentation and optimization opportunities. This role also coordinates creative assets, engages with our online community, manages assigned vendor relationships and leads communication initiatives that advance the broader marketing strategy.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage daily loyalty program communications, including point-earning, rewards and member-only campaigns.
* Build, QA and deploy scheduled email and SMS campaigns for retail (B2C) and wholesale (B2B) audiences per the content calendar.
* Perform pre-send QA on links, personalization, compliance language, opt-out language and send timing; track error rates and resolve issues before deployment.
* Build and refine tailored audience segments to optimize digital programmatic advertising.
* Maintain segmentation list hygiene and opt-in/opt-out accuracy in line with TCPA, carrier and state regulations.
* Develop and execute testing strategies across subject lines, content, audience segments and send times; independently evaluate results and implement changes to improve future campaign performance.
* Develop and manage the social content strategy and calendar, making recommendations on content mix, channel approach, timing and audience engagement based on business priorities, performance data and platform trends.
* Determine and optimize email, SMS and social communication timing, audience segmentation and channel approach based on campaign objectives, customer behavior and performance results.
* Evaluate campaigns for compliance with established state cannabis advertising requirements and platform policies; identify compliance risks, determine appropriate corrective action within established guidelines, and escalate novel or material issues when necessary.
* Manage assigned marketing vendor relationships, evaluate vendor performance and service needs, resolve issues, and recommend changes to vendors, services or spending based on business needs and performance.
* Collaborate with Brand Ambassadors to capture field & event content.
* Coordinate with Creative Services on assets and copy to meet production deadlines.
* Monitor comments and direct messages, respond per brand guidelines, and escalate customer service or compliance issues to the appropriate team.
* Produce and deploy communications to third party partners, including new product launches, promotions and sell-in materials, and co-branded campaigns in partnership with the Wholesale team.
* Analyze weekly and monthly performance across email, SMS and social channels; identify trends, risks and opportunities; and develop and implement recommendations to improve engagement, conversion, redemption, deliverability and audience growth.
* Serve as a subject-matter resource to Marketing and business partners on email, SMS and social channel strategy, audience segmentation, campaign performance and communication best practices.
* Lead assigned cross-functional marketing initiatives and recommend communication approaches that support broader marketing and business objectives.

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* On-time send/publish rate against the content calendar, across email, SMS, and social.
* Pre-send QA defect rate (errors caught before send vs. after).
* Social response time to comments/messages against defined service standard.
* Campaign and content performance trends (open/click/redemption/engagement rate) reported monthly.
* Social media growth metric reporting.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* 2+ years marketing experience; email/SMS platform experience (Klaviyo, Springbig, Alpine IQ, or similar) preferred.
* Familiarity with social media scheduling/publishing tools and platform-specific best practices (Meta, YouTube, TikTok, etc) required.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and comfort with a daily production cadence across multiple channels.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-motivated with a proactive approach to tasks.
* Punctual, reliable, and adaptable to occasional evening and weekend work.
* 1+ years CRM platform experience (Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.) a plus.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Occasional lifting, carrying, or transporting of marketing materials, signage, or event supplies (up to 25 pounds) may be required.
* This role requires prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

**Our Benefits:**

* Paid time off (PTO) including 8 paid holidays per year\*
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance\*
* 401k retirement savings plan\*
* Company paid Short-Term & Long-Term disability\*
* Company paid Life Insurance\*
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee referral program
* Commuter benefits\*
* Product discounts
* Additional compensation incentives (tips, bonuses, etc.)

* For full-time positions only

jobs.description:
Oak View Group:

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary:

Oak View Group is seeking a dynamic **Marketing Manager** to lead promotional campaigns across Lexington's premier entertainment portfolio: Rupp Arena, Central Bank Center, the Lexington Opera House, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park. This Marketing Manager position will develop, manage, and execute strategic marketing plans to ensure the success of events. The position will serve as a venue marketer, responsible for overseeing event advertising budgets, the media buying process, public relations, and grassroots promotions for concerts, family shows, and conventions.

This role pays an annual salary of $50,000 - $55,000.

**Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays)**

**This position will remain open until December 31, 2026.**

About the Venue:

Lexington is an active and thriving market, craving an active and welcoming venue for events. The heart of any thriving community is its downtown—and Lexington Center and the historic **Rupp Arena** are truly the heart of downtown Lexington and one of the most widely recognized entertainment venues in North America. Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky, is fast becoming THE must-play venue. The 20,000-seat arena, affectionately referred to by some as “the Cathedral of College Basketball," is home to the National Champion University of Kentucky men’s basketball program and has played host to some of the most talented and award-winning musicians/artists in the world, including U2, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Justin Timberlake, Kenny Chesney, Taylor Swift, and many others.

Central Bank Center is our convention side, with over 99k sf of exhibition space, 24k sf each of meeting and ballroom space, 50k of hospitality space, 10k sf of flexible space, and over 2500 covered and uncovered parking spaces. Both venues are additionally joined in entertaining this area by the Lexington Opera House, showcasing Broadway talent through collaborative bookings of Broadway shows, small venue concerts, and local arts.

CommonSpirit Health Stage at Gatton Park is a 5,000-capacity outdoor venue located in the center of Lexington. From live music and stand-up comedy to unforgettable experiences set against a stunning park backdrop in the center of the city.

Founded in 2021, Lexington Sporting Club is an American professional soccer team based in Lexington, KY. The soccer complex off Athens-Boonesboro Road near I-75 opened in August 2024 in time for the organization’s first USL Super League season.

Responsibilities:

* Conceptualize, develop, and execute comprehensive marketing campaigns to promote concerts, comedy shows, theater productions, and live events at Rupp Arena, the Lexington Opera House, Central Bank Center, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park
* Develop and implement creative cash/trade proposals with media partners, including digital, radio, print, TV, and outdoor
* Create and maintain collaborative relationships with local media partners, promoters, tour marketers, and community partners to ensure fully aligned event campaigns
* Explore and execute cross-marketing opportunities throughout the community and execute grassroots marketing, including but not limited to ticket giveaways, on-site activations, and third-party partnerships
* Manage internal marketing assets, oversee digital displays and marquee messaging, and maintain the venue website
* Manage event advertising budgets, oversee the media buying and billing process, and implement multi-channel advertising strategies
* Draft, distribute, and follow up on press releases, pitching feature stories to local and regional media for upcoming events and venue initiatives
* Conceptualize and collaborate on social media campaigns, email and SMS marketing, and promotions to drive ticket sales and fan engagement
* Track, analyze, and compare event ticket sales information, adjusting digital targeting parameters and overall efforts based on gathered analytics from previous events
* Prepare post-show recaps and manage post-event survey evaluations to measure attendee feedback and analyze venue operations
* Research and follow current venue and event marketing trends, implementing best practices in day-to-day activations
* Recruit and manage marketing interns and part-time employees
* Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent work experiences
* 3-5 years of previous event or entertainment marketing experience preferred
* Intermediate to strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
* Strong knowledge of social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, etc.)
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
* Basic photography and videography skills with proficiency in editing images/videos using the following software: Adobe, Canva, and CapCut
* Independent decision-making skills; ability and knowledge to apply judgment in resolving problems of moderate scope and complexity
* Highly organized, resourceful, quick learner, and able to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
* Must be adaptable with the ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines

Overview:

Sono-Tek Corporation is seeking a versatile, creative, and highly organized **Marketing Specialist** to coordinate and execute marketing activities across the entire company.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys wearing many hats and taking ownership of a wide variety of responsibilities. As Sono-Tek's primary in-house marketing resource, this individual will serve as the company's marketing department, coordinating marketing initiatives, supporting the development and execution of marketing strategies, and managing day-to-day marketing activities.

The position has no direct reports but involves significant collaboration with executive management, Sales, Engineering, outside marketing consultants, distributors, and other departments. The successful candidate will help translate company priorities into effective marketing initiatives while independently managing projects from concept through completion.

Responsibilities span digital marketing, graphic design, corporate presentations, investor relations materials, social media, trade shows, video production, website management, branding, and internal company communications.

While graphic design and creative capabilities remain important, Sono-Tek places significant value on candidates who embrace artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance marketing effectiveness.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who enjoys variety, is comfortable working independently, and can balance creative thinking with hands-on execution. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants broad marketing experience, meaningful responsibility, and visibility throughout a growing technology company.

**Location:** Milton, NY (Onsite)  
**Position Type:** Full-Time  
**Compensation** **Annual Salary Range:** $55,000–$70,000, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated skills.

**Marketing Coordination & Strategy**

* Maintain professional and consistent branding across corporate and investor relations materials.

**Photography, Video & Multimedia**

* Take, edit, organize, and maintain photographs of company equipment, products, applications, employees, and corporate events.

* Manage video content for the company website, YouTube, and other distribution platforms.
* Create visual content for use in sales presentations, trade shows, marketing literature, and digital communications.

* Coordinate the creation and production of trade show graphics, posters, displays, and promotional materials.

jobs.title: Commercial Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Lumicell received approval in 2024 and has completed its initial commercial launch. The Commercial Marketing Manager will build on that foundation by developing and executing programs that drive adoption, increase utilization and grow revenue. This hands-on role will translate commercial strategy into coordinated, compliant execution across product marketing, sales enablement, physician education, KOL engagement, market development and marketing operations. The successful candidate will bring structure, urgency and strong cross-functional partnership to programs designed to expand the impact of Lumicell’s approved product.

**What You’ll Own**

**Marketing Planning & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Own the marketing project plan and maintain clear visibility into priorities, deadlines, dependencies, decisions and risks.
* Translate the annual marketing strategy into actionable workstreams, deliverables and performance measures.
* Coordinate across Sales, Commercial Excellence, Health Economics, Market Access, Clinical, Regulatory, Legal and Integrated Communications to keep programs aligned and moving forward.
* Track marketing performance, campaign effectiveness, market trends and budget needs; communicate progress and recommended actions.
* Provide clear direction, priorities, feedback and accountability to external partners supporting execution of the commercial marketing plan.

**Sales Enablement & Field Support**

* Develop and maintain field-facing tools, messaging, presentations and educational materials that support consistent customer conversations.
* Gather feedback from the field and customers, identify recurring needs, and convert insights into practical marketing actions.
* Partner with Sales and Commercial Excellence to support training, adoption and effective use of approved materials.

**Product Marketing & Commercialization**

* Develop clear, compelling messaging and value propositions for clinicians, hospitals, health systems, patients and advocacy groups.
* Plan and execute launch-readiness activities for Lumicell’s breast cancer solution, the first indication of its pan-cancer platform technology.

We're building a community for entrepreneurs, founders, and creatives who want to connect, learn, and grow alongside like-minded people.

Through networking mixers, workshops, intimate gatherings, and activity-based experiences, we create opportunities for people to build genuine relationships, exchange ideas, and experience entrepreneurship together.

***This is an unpaid volunteer opportunity, and we're transparent about that from the start.*** We're looking for someone who genuinely connects with our mission and wants to contribute their skills in a collaborative, flexible, and low-pressure environment.

We're looking for a Volunteer Social Media Coordinator to help grow our social media presence and showcase the experiences, people, and ideas that make our community unique.

Working directly with our co-founder responsible for marketing and branding, you'll help turn our events, behind-the-scenes moments, and community vision into engaging content that builds awareness, attracts new audiences, and encourages people to attend future gatherings.

**What You'll Gain**

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - Threat Research
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Cyera is building the next generation of AI and data security. Our platform empowers security teams to manage and protect all of their company’s sensitive data. Cyera provides visibility and insight into your data, identities, AI agents and access, and delivers actionable guidance to minimize cyber-risks stemming from exposure, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and runtime threats.

Backed by the world’s leading cyber investors and led by a strong, dynamic team of technical and industry experts, Cyera is scaling and gaining market traction quickly.

As AI agents and non-human identities reshape the threat landscape, original security research has become one of the most credible ways to earn trust with security leaders. To power our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Threat Research to turn Cyera’s data, AI, and identity security expertise into a research-led marketing engine. You will partner with our researchers and product teams to uncover, package, and publish original threat research that builds Cyera’s authority in the market and drives pipeline.

This position is 100% from anywhere in the US, eastern time zone strongly preferred.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Build and run a threat research publishing program, including AI security research, threat reports, vulnerability disclosures, and data-driven industry findings
* Partner with Cyera’s researchers, Product, and Data Science to identify compelling research angles and translate technical findings into clear, credible narratives for security practitioners and executives
* Create and manage the full research content portfolio: blogs, technical write-ups, flagship reports, briefs, webinars, and conference talks
* Develop go-to-market plans that connect research to Cyera’s positioning, messaging, and product value, and equip Sales and Customer Success with the stories and talking points to use it
* Drive launch and amplification of research across media, analyst, social, and community channels, building relationships with security press and industry influencers
* Track and report on research impact, including share of voice, media and analyst pickup, engagement, and influenced pipeline
* Monitor the threat landscape and competitive research output to find gaps where Cyera can lead, particularly in AI security and non-human identity risk
* Serve as a market-facing subject matter expert and thought leader for Cyera

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years of product marketing, security content marketing, or threat research communications experience

* Demonstrated ability to translate deeply technical research into compelling content for both technical and executive audiences
* Strong writing and editing skills, with a portfolio of published research-driven content
* Working knowledge of the threat landscape, including AI and LLM security risks, data exposure, and identity-based threats
* Experience launching research through PR, analyst relations, and owned channels
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills

**Nice to have**

* Experience working directly with security researchers or a threat intelligence team
* Familiarity with vulnerability disclosure and responsible publication practices
* Background in a technical security role

Compensation Range: $200,000-$230,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

**BENEFITS - Why Cyera?**

* Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
* Competitive salary

jobs.title: VP, Growth Marketing

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**What you'll own**  
  
**1) MRR, growth and forecast accountability**

* Own new MRR, expansion and growth targets across ABC Trainerize and ABC FitMetrics; establish clear goals, pacing and priorities with executive, Product, Finance and Marketing stakeholders.
* Establish a consistent global cadence for performance review, experimentation and corrective action; ensure teams are aligned around shared definitions and measurable outcomes.
* Align customer segmentation, growth opportunities and product-led plays with Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
* Balance short-term performance with sustainable improvements in activation, adoption, conversion, retention and expansion.

**2) Growth strategy across channels (execution via team + agency)**

* **Paid acquisition (SEM + Paid Social + Programmatic) — governance & outcomes:** Set strategy, channel roles, investment thesis and guardrails across products and regions; lead agency selection and management; and drive budget pacing and reallocation based on performance, marginal returns and incrementality.
* **Web + conversion rate optimization (CRO):** Own the digital funnel from discovery through activation and conversion; build a CRO program with a clear hypothesis backlog, experimentation velocity and analytics hygiene, driving measurable improvements in CVR, CAC, activation, conversion and MRR.
* **Lifecycle and marketing automation:** Scale lifecycle programs that improve onboarding, activation, adoption, conversion, retention and expansion; define segmentation and personalization standards; and partner with Product, Implementation and Customer Success to turn product and customer signals into meaningful growth opportunities.
* **SEO + AEO (LLM visibility) + content-led growth:** Scale technical SEO, answer engine optimization and intent-led content performance in partnership with Marketing and content teams; build durable organic growth through comparisons, FAQs, schema, buyer-intent answers and other high-value content.
* **Social, influencer and digital distribution:** Build a stronger social, influencer, affiliate, partner and community growth motion where appropriate, with clear objectives, learning agendas and quality standards.
* **Growth loops and emerging channels:** Identify underdeveloped acquisition channels, growth loops and new revenue opportunities; test, learn and scale the channels that create sustainable customer and product growth.

**3) Executive-level performance management, reporting and analytics (core)**

* Create and own the PLG Operating System: weekly business reviews, monthly performance reviews and quarterly planning with executive, Product, Engineering and Marketing leadership.
* Build executive-ready reporting tying investment to outcomes: new MRR, expansion, activation, adoption, conversion, retention, CAC/payback, channel mix and forecast versus plan by product and channel.
* Partner with Finance and Analytics to establish a single source of truth across product, CRM and marketing platforms, including shared definitions, data quality standards and governance.
* Implement decision-grade measurement using attribution guardrails, incrementality and lift testing, holdouts, geo tests and standardized dashboards that highlight performance, risks and actions.
* Own forecasting and scenario planning across base, upside and downside cases, with explicit assumptions and spend-to-growth sensitivity.

**4) Full-funnel customer journey, conversion and cross-functional alignment**

Functioning as an integrated individual lead backed by extended resources, this individual oversees external vendor agencies, offshore contractors, and artificial intelligence solutions to construct a unified performance engine. **Join our team as a VP of Marketing and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!**

**Location:** Remote - US East Coast

**Reports to:** Chief Business Officer

**About Turbine**

A lab without limits, built for biopharma.

Turbine’s Virtual Lab (vLab®) enables scientists to run Virtual Assays across millions of biological conditions far beyond traditional laboratory throughput. Instead of narrowing hypotheses to fit experimental constraints, scientists can explore the broader biological search space computationally before deciding what to validate in the wet lab. Turbine doesn’t replace the wet lab. It makes every experiment count. Through an integrated lab-in-the-loop workflow, virtual findings become testable hypotheses, with validation results feeding back to strengthen subsequent predictions within the workflow.

In deployed programs, Turbine has reduced decision timelines from 12-18 months to approximately two months while cutting wet-lab experiments by more than 50%.

Working with scientists at leading biopharma like MSD (Merck & Co.), AstraZeneca and Bayer, Turbine’s virtual assays have rationalized experiments across more than 30 discovery programs.

Backed by leading tech and industry investors like Accel, MSD Global Health Innovation Fund, Interactive Venture Partners and Beiersdorf, Turbine is turning biology into an engineering discipline.

**Job Summary**

In this role, you will be the visual voice of our practice, responsible for filming high-quality educational and promotional content, editing engaging short- and long-form videos, and managing our daily social channels.

You will work closely with our ENT physicians, audiologists, and clinical staff to demystify ear, nose, and throat health - ranging from pediatric ENT and sinus care to hearing loss and sleep apnea - while maintaining strict patient privacy (HIPAA) standards. Additionally, you will serve as the first point of contact for our online community by managing inbound comments and direct messages.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan, direct, and record original visual and audio content within the clinic, including physician interviews, procedural explainers, patient testimonials, behind-the-scenes footage, and educational Q&As.
* Operate camera gear, mobile rigs, lighting kits, and wireless microphones to ensure high production value in clinical settings.
* Coordinate with clinical staff to identify filming opportunities that do not disrupt patient flow or clinical operations.
* Secure and file proper media releases and HIPAA-compliant consent documentation prior to recording any patient or procedure.
* Edit dynamic, platform-native video assets for Instagram (Reels), TikTok, YouTube (Shorts & Long-form), Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Add captions, sound design, motion graphics, transitions, and on-brand typography optimized for mobile viewing.
* Repurpose long-form educational talks and podcast-style segments into digestible micro-content.
* Design complementary static assets, carousels, and YouTube thumbnails using Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
* Monitor daily direct messages, public comments, mentions, and online reviews across all active social platforms.
* Deliver prompt, empathetic, and professional responses using approved clinical communication guidelines.
* Direct prospective patients to booking portals or the clinic’s scheduling department.
* Strictly maintain healthcare privacy standards: recognize potential HIPAA liabilities and never provide individualized medical advice in public or private online channels.
* Maintain a consistent content calendar reflecting health awareness months, seasonal ENT trends (e.g., allergy seasons, cold/flu season), and clinic priorities.
* Track platform analytics (engagement rates, follower growth, inbound click-throughs, inquiries) and deliver monthly performance recaps.
* Stay current with social media algorithms, trending audio, editing formats, and healthcare marketing ethics.

* Working knowledge of graphic design tools (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva).
* Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to translate complex medical terminology into clear, accessible, and engaging patient-facing content.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Film Production, or a related field is preferred or 1-2 years of experience in multimedia content creation, videography, video editing, and social media management.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Prolonged period of standing, moving, and bending.
* Must be able to use photography equipment, such as cameras, lights, and microphones.
* Must be able to lift up to 20 pounds at times.

Pay: From $19.00 per hour

Benefits:

jobs.description:
Title: Marketing Manager  
Reports to: CEO  
Position: Exempt, Salary  
Location: Hybrid, Phoenix, AZ

**ZELUS is a U.S.-owned BIM and VDC consulting firm with roughly 17 years in the field, working in all 50 states for 20+ Fortune 500 clients. We serve owners, developers, architects, contractors and engineers through two divisions:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Existing Conditions (ExCon) — laser scanning and reality capture by our own field crews, delivered as accurate scan-to-BIM models.
* Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) — model coordination and subject-matter expertise that keeps complex builds on schedule and on budget.

Our goal is simple: be the best and most recognized scan-to-BIM and VDC company in the United States.

**The role**
------------

The Marketing Manager owns ZELUS's pipeline engine and national brand. You'll build an AI-powered marketing operation that fills the sales funnel with qualified owner, GC and design-firm leads, and make ZELUS the first name people think of for scan-to-BIM and VDC.

This is a builder role, not a maintenance role. You'll test new go-to-market plays fast, keep what works, cut what doesn't, and show the numbers behind every decision.

### **Lead generation**

* Build and run multi-channel demand generation — LinkedIn, paid search, email nurture, webinars and industry events — aimed at owners, developers, GCs, architects and engineers.
* Use AI tools to identify target accounts, enrich contact data, score intent and personalize outreach at scale.
* Run account-based marketing for Fortune 500 owners and top national GCs, in lockstep with business development.
* Own the CRM and marketing automation stack: clean data, clear lead stages, and a clean handoff from marketing-qualified to sales-qualified.
* Track cost per lead, pipeline created and win rate by channel, and shift budget to what produces revenue.

### **Brand recognition**

* Sharpen ZELUS's positioning so the market sees one clear story: accurate scan-to-BIM and VDC, delivered nationally, by a firm with 17 years of proof.
* Turn project wins into case studies, before-and-after model visuals, short videos and client testimonials.
* Grow ZELUS's presence at key industry events and associations (e.g., AGC, AIA, SMPS, Autodesk University, SPAR/Geo Week), including speaking slots and awards submissions.
* Lead website strategy, SEO and content so ZELUS ranks for the searches our buyers make — "scan to BIM," "laser scanning services," "VDC coordination."
* Build thought leadership for ZELUS leaders on LinkedIn and in trade press.

### **AI-driven go-to-market**

* Make AI part of how marketing works every day: content drafting, research, campaign testing, analytics and reporting.
* Set up AI-enabled workflows that let a lean team produce like a large one, with clear review standards for accuracy and brand voice.
* Watch how buyers now find vendors through AI search and assistants, and make sure ZELUS shows up there.
* Test new channels and plays quickly, measure them honestly, and scale the winners.

### **Planning and budget**

* Build the annual marketing plan and budget tied to ZELUS growth targets by division.
* Report monthly to the CEO on pipeline, spend and return.
* Manage agencies, freelancers and tools; hire as the function grows.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 5+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years owning lead generation and a pipeline number.
* Hands-on, daily use of AI tools for content, research, analytics and campaign execution — and a portfolio that shows it.
* Proven results growing a brand and pipeline for a professional-services or technical firm.
* Strong command of a CRM and marketing automation platform (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce).
* Comfort with data: you set up tracking, read the numbers and make the call.
* Clear, sharp writing and the judgment to keep technical content accurate.
* Self-starter who moves fast and owns outcomes.

### **Preferred**

* Experience marketing to the AEC industry — owners, GCs, architects or engineers.
* Working knowledge of BIM, VDC, Revit, laser scanning or reality capture.
* Account-based marketing experience with enterprise or Fortune 500 buyers.
* Experience managing agencies and a marketing budget.
* SMPS membership or CPSM certification.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field.

ZELUS is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

jobs.title: Paid Media Manager, Hybrid
jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.

For more information, visit our Careers page.

About Hybrid

Recently acquired by EAB, Hybrid is a globally recognized and award-winning agency that operates as a full-service marketing partner for the education sector, connecting universities with students worldwide. Powered by unrivaled insight, advanced technology, and AI-driven enrollment strategies, our integrated marketing solutions help education brands grow. We tackle the sector’s toughest challenges head-on and continuously strive for excellence, staying on the pulse of emerging trends. When you join our division of EAB, you become part of a tight-knit, ambitious, supportive, and rapidly growing team. You’ll work on big ideas with talented colleagues who respect your input, challenge your thinking and push you to do your best work. Visit our website to learn more about our story

**The Role in Brief:**

**Paid Media Manager, Hybrid**

Hybrid is seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Paid Media Manager to join our growing Digital team. This role is ideal for a paid media professional who enjoys balancing hands-on campaign execution with leadership, mentoring, and strategic planning.

As a Paid Media Manager, you will oversee high-performing paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic channels while partnering with Account Directors, Digital leadership, and clients to develop innovative marketing strategies that drive enrollment and brand growth for higher education institutions worldwide.

In addition to managing complex digital campaigns, you'll play a key role in developing team capabilities, improving operational processes, and helping shape the continued growth of Hybrid's Paid Media function. This is an outstanding opportunity for someone looking to expand their leadership experience while remaining deeply involved in digital strategy and campaign performance.

This hire may be based in Philadelphia, PA, Richmond, VA, or Washington, D.C.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

The Paid Media Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, optimization, and strategic direction of paid media campaigns while supporting the growth and development of Hybrid's Digital team.

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Lead the planning, launch, optimization, and reporting of paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic channels.

* Develop sophisticated campaign strategies, audience targeting, bidding approaches, and measurement frameworks.

* Oversee campaign pacing, budget allocation, and performance to ensure client goals are achieved.

* Manage complex campaign builds while maintaining exceptional quality and attention to detail.

**Client Strategy & Performance**

* Serve as a trusted digital marketing advisor to clients by translating campaign performance into strategic recommendations.

* Present campaign insights, reporting, and optimization strategies during client meetings.

* Develop detailed performance analyses, competitor research, and actionable recommendations.

* Partner with Account Directors to support integrated media planning and long-term client success.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Mentor, coach, and support Paid Media Executives and junior team members.

* Share best practices, technical expertise, and platform knowledge across the Digital team.

* Identify opportunities to improve team workflows, campaign processes, and operational efficiency.

* Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment focused on continuous learning and innovation.

**Digital Innovation & Operational Excellence**

* Stay current on emerging advertising platforms, industry trends, and evolving best practices.

* Leverage Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, Snapchat, and other advertising platforms to deliver innovative client solutions.

* Manage multiple client campaigns and competing priorities while ensuring timely execution.

* Support the continued growth and evolution of Hybrid's Paid Media capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

* 4-6+ years of experience managing paid digital media campaigns in an agency or similar client-facing environment.

* Demonstrated experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other major paid media platforms.

* Strong knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, campaign tracking, and performance reporting.

* Experience presenting campaign strategy and results to clients and senior stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Experience leading or mentoring digital marketing team members.

* Experience managing six-figure digital advertising budgets across multiple client accounts.

* Deep understanding of paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, audience targeting, and attribution.

annually, depending on experience.

* Improve how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products through our online store.

* Plan and execute digital campaigns across appropriate channels, including search, social media, and email.
* Manage paid advertising directly or oversee outside support, depending on the campaign and available resources.
* Work with website and technical staff to improve product listings, conversion tracking, shopping experience, and campaign measurement.
* Develop programs that encourage repeat purchases and continued customer engagement.

Bios Wellness Clinics’ multi-disciplinary approach is aimed at redefining excellence in care through innovative technologies. Our mission is to provide cutting-edge treatments in medical aesthetics and complementary & alternative medicine to enhance the well-being of our patients.

**WHY BIOS**

At Bios Wellness Clinics, we are committed to innovation and excellence in medical aesthetics and wellness. Our team members are equipped with cutting-edge tools, ongoing professional development opportunities, and a collaborative environment where creativity and collaboration are valued. By joining Bios, you’ll thrive in a forward-thinking organization that emphasizes both your personal growth and the delivery of exceptional patient care, setting us apart in the industry.

The SEO Copywriter, Medical Aesthetics is the writer behind the content that helps Bios' clinics across North America connect with patients and grow. This role writes short-form video scripts, carousels, social captions, emails, ad copy and website pages, with SEO built into every piece so each clinic stands out in search, on social platforms and in AI search tools.

In a regulated industry, accuracy matters. The SEO Copywriter turns complex information about a wide range of treatments into clear, compliant copy that follows the advertising rules of each province or state where our clinics operate.

Working in Monday.com, Klaviyo, WordPress, SEMrush and all major social platforms, this role plans, writes and optimizes content for several clinics at once, keeping each one true to its own voice. The result is a stronger online presence for every clinic, more patients through the door and lasting trust built on reliable information.

**Social Content Scripts and Carousels**

* Write scripts for Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and Stories: a hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds, talking points or voiceover, on-screen text, suggested shots and a call to action.
* Write scripts practitioners and content creators can deliver naturally on camera, in simple language with room for their own personality.
* Write carousel copy slide by slide (usually 5 to 10 slides) explaining a treatment, skin concern, myth or process, with direction for designers on each slide.
* Build repeatable series, such as “how it works,” “myth vs. fact” and “what to expect,” that work across clinics and treatments.
* Adapt one core idea for several clinics so each version fits that clinic’s voice, treatment menu and community without sounding copied.

* Write captions for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube with natural keywords, treatment names, concerns and local place names so posts show up in platform search.
* Tailor captions to each platform: length, format, hashtags, alt text and first comments.
* Keep an up-to-date keyword and hashtag list for each clinic and treatment.
* Include a clear next step in every caption, such as booking a consultation or visiting the website.

**Email Marketing**

* Write educational and promotional emails for each clinic in Klaviyo: subject lines, preview text, body copy and calls to action.
* Write and maintain automated flows: welcome series, consultation follow-up, pre- and post-treatment education, reminders, memberships, reactivation and win-back.

* Make sure every email meets anti-spam law for its audience: CASL in Canada and CAN-SPAM in the US.

**Ad Copy**

* Write ad copy for paid social and search campaigns with the paid media team: headlines, primary text, descriptions and calls to action.

**Website Copy**

**We Are Looking For:**

State Street is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Head of Digital Strategy & Channels, Senior Vice President, to lead the firm's digital marketing ecosystem and core channels.

This is a senior role for a proven strategist and operator: someone who has built and run digital marketing capabilities at scale, and who can move comfortably between setting enterprise vision and rolling up their sleeves to improve channel performance. This leader will take an enterprise, State Street-wide view of our key user journeys and the distinct personas we serve across our businesses, and design digital experiences and capabilities around each business's specific growth outcomes.

The successful candidate will lead a global organization of digital strategists, UX specialists and operators to define and drive the strategic vision for State Street's digital experiences in partnership with marketing, technology, product, and design teams, creating seamless, personalized experiences that drive engagement and business growth. From a strategy standpoint, this person's focus is efficacy and maturity: every channel decision should be traceable to measurable business impact, not activity for its own sake. They will build an operating model that guides marketing programs to be deeply rooted in audience behavior, embeds a genuine test-and-learn discipline, and gives the team a real, repeatable ability to operationalize channel improvements based on what the data shows.

The role reports to the Global Chief Marketing Officer and as part of the global marketing leadership team will help architect our broader transformation into a high-performing, data-led strategic partner and growth driver for the business.

The Director of Marketing is responsible for leading the strategic execution, operational effectiveness, and commercial performance of Eberlestock's Marketing Department. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this position provides senior-level leadership across E-Commerce, Brand, Creative, Marketing Operations, and related marketing functions, ensuring that the department operates as a cohesive, accountable, and results-driven organization.

Working in partnership with the CMO, the Director of Marketing translates the company's brand vision and business objectives into integrated marketing strategies that drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and long-term brand equity. A critical component of this role is deep expertise in direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce marketing. The Director of Marketing must possess a strong understanding of digital acquisition, paid media performance, return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion rate optimization, retention marketing, and the financial drivers of a successful e-commerce business.

Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world's fastest-growing digital brands. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!
