jobs.title: Videographer - Retail Marketing
jobs.description:
**Videographer - Retail Marketing**
===================================

**Location:** Midvale, UT 84047

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Retail Marketing Videographer produces the video that sells mophie product at retail — including in-store display and endcap loops, demo and feature-explainer videos for retail partner product pages, launch assets for the retail channel, and sales-enablement and trade show content. This role shoots in-studio and on location, edits, and builds motion graphics in After Effects, delivering assets that conform to each retail partner's specifications and to mophie brand standards.

The ideal candidate is a polished, detail-driven craftsperson: strong on camera, lighting, and audio; fluent in After Effects; and comfortable working to fixed specifications, brand guidelines, and a retail calendar with hard in-store dates. This role does not own social channels. Social-first vertical content sits with the Social Media Videographer; this role may supply source footage and cutdowns to that function.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Shoot**

* Shoot product, tabletop, and lifestyle video in-studio and on location
* Operate camera, lighting, and audio on solo and small-crew shoots
* Set up and strike studio lighting, grip and set; light product for clean, repeatable brand-standard results
* Serve as second camera / camera operator on larger campaign shoots
* Shoot demo and how-to content that shows product function clearly and accurately
* Capture on location at retail environments, events, and trade shows as needed

### **Edit and Animate**

* Edit retail marketing video from raw capture through final delivery
* Build motion graphics in After Effects: product callouts, feature animations, spec cards, lower thirds, and end frames
* Maintain and extend After Effects templates so recurring asset types stay consistent and fast to produce
* Edit for silent playback first — in-store screens run without audio, so meaning carries on visuals and on-screen text
* Color and finish to brand standard across all delivered content
* Version and conform assets to each retail partner's aspect ratio, runtime, loop, and file-format specs

### **Retail Channel**

* Produce in-store display, endcap, kiosk, and shelf-screen loops
* Produce product-page and listing video for retail partner and e-commerce placements
* Deliver launch video packages for the retail channel, timed to in-store and on-shelf dates
* Produce sales-enablement and trade show video for the retail sales team
* Work from retail partner brand guidelines and co-op marketing requirements without needing them re-explained each cycle
* Partner with retail marketing and product teams on messaging, claims, and feature accuracy

### **Operate**

* Manage media end to end: ingest, back up, organize, and archive footage to team standards
* Deliver against a retail calendar with fixed, non-moving in-store dates
* Maintain camera and studio equipment; flag repair and replacement needs
* Contribute ideas in content planning, shot listing, and batch shoot prep

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Experience**

* 3–5 years of professional video production and editing experience
* Reel or portfolio demonstrating product, commercial, or brand marketing video
* Experience delivering to fixed specifications and brand guidelines, not just open creative briefs

### **Camera, Lighting and Audio**

* Strong fundamentals in camera operation (mirrorless or cinema bodies)
* Studio lighting: strobe and continuous, including product and tabletop setups
* Location lighting and the judgment to work quickly in uncontrolled spaces
* Production audio: mics, levels, and clean capture on interview and demo setups
* Comfortable with gimbal work — stabilized movement, tracking, and walk-and-talk shots

### **Post Production**

* Adobe After Effects: motion graphics, product animation, and template building and maintenance
* Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve
* Color grading to a consistent brand standard
* Confident versioning and conforming assets across multiple aspect ratios, runtimes, and delivery specs

### **AI Skills**

* Baseline working fluency is expected; not an AI specialist but a user who leverages AI tools to move faster
* Comfortable using AI in normal post workflow: generative fill and object removal, background cleanup and extension, rotoscoping and tracking assistance, upscaling, transcription, and auto-captioning
* Able to write clear prompts and iterate toward usable results rather than accepting the first output
* Uses AI for supporting work — asset versioning, copy and on-screen text drafts, concept and storyboard exploration — while keeping final creative judgment their own
* Understands limits in a retail context: product must be represented accurately, with no fabricated product imagery, invented features, unverified claims, or AI-generated likeness without clearance
* Willing to learn and adopt new tools as the team's workflow changes

### **Working Style**

* Able to manage multiple deliverables on deadline with minimal supervision
* Precise about specs, file naming, versioning, and delivery — retail dates do not move
* Able to lift and move production equipment up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods on shoot days

### **Preferred**

* Consumer electronics, accessories, or other consumer-products brand experience
* Experience delivering to major retail partners and their asset specifications
* Advanced color grading and node-based workflows in DaVinci Resolve
* 3D product animation or render work (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)
* Still photography capability for retail, packaging, and e-commerce use
* Experience with packaging, POP, or print production and how video assets sit alongside them
* Trade show or event production experience

jobs.title: Videographer - Social Media
jobs.description:
**Videographer - Social Media**
===============================

**Location:** Midvale, UT, 84047

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Social Media Videographer owns mophie's social-first video output end to end — concept, capture, edit, publish and iterate. This role shoots product and lifestyle content in-studio and on location, cuts vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and works from platform performance data rather than a fixed shot list. The role also serves as second camera on Tier 1 campaign shoots led by the Senior Video Producer. The ideal candidate is a creator first and an operator second: fluent in what is working on each platform right now, fast enough to turn a trend around inside its window, and self-sufficient from idea to posted asset without heavy oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Create**

* Shoot product and lifestyle video in-studio and on location, solo and on small crews
* Edit social-first vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts — raw capture through final delivery
* Operate camera, lighting and audio on solo and small-crew shoots; set up and strike studio lighting, grip and set
* Serve as second camera / camera operator on Tier 1 campaign shoots
* Cut multiple hooks, lengths and aspect ratios from a single shoot for testing across placements
* Shoot and edit lo-fi, creator-style content where the polished version would underperform

### **Publish and Grow**

* Own the social content calendar day to day: pitch, batch, schedule and publish against it
* Source trends, sounds and formats weekly, and flag which ones mophie should move on
* Write captions, hooks, on-screen text and hashtags fitted to each platform
* Read performance in native analytics and adjust the next round of content to what the data shows
* Support community management: surface comment themes, reply-worthy moments and content requests back to the team

### **Operate**

* Manage media end to end: ingest, back up, organize and archive footage to team standards
* Maintain consistent framing, color and pacing across all delivered content
* Deliver fast-turn content against short deadlines, including same-day reactive posts
* Repurpose Tier 1 campaign footage into social cutdowns
* Maintain camera and studio equipment; flag repair and replacement needs
* Contribute ideas in content planning, shot listing and batch shoot prep

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 2–4 years producing and editing video for brand or creator social channels
* Reel or portfolio of social-first vertical work, with performance numbers attached to at least some of it
* Track record of owning content from idea through posted asset, not just the edit

### **Craft**

* Strong fundamentals in camera operation (mirrorless or cinema bodies), lighting and audio
* Comfortable with gimbal work — stabilized movement, tracking and walk-and-talk shots
* Confident shooting on phone when the format calls for it, and able to make it look intentional
* On-camera presence or comfort directing non-actors and internal talent

### **Tools**

* Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve; working knowledge of After Effects
* CapCut or an equivalent fast-turn mobile and desktop editor
* Native platform editors and publishing tools across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
* A social scheduling and analytics platform (Later, Sprout Social, Dash Hudson or similar)

### **AI Skills**

Baseline working fluency is expected. We are not looking for an AI specialist — we are looking for someone who already uses these tools to move faster and knows where they don't belong.

* Comfortable using AI in a normal production workflow: transcription and auto-captioning, generative fill and object removal, background cleanup, upscaling, rough-cut and b-roll assistance
* Able to write clear prompts and iterate toward a usable result rather than accepting the first output
* Uses AI for supporting work — caption drafts, hook and headline variations, concept and shot list brainstorming — while keeping final creative judgment their own
* Understands the limits: no fabricated product imagery, invented features or unverified claims, and no AI-generated likeness without clearance
* Willing to learn and adopt new tools as the team's workflow changes

### **Platform**

* Current working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts specs, formats and ranking behavior
* Able to read native analytics — retention curves, watch time, saves, shares — and explain what to change
* Fluent in platform culture: what a trend is worth, when it has passed, and what will read as trying too hard

### **Working Style**

* Able to manage multiple deliverables on deadline with minimal supervision
* Able to lift and move production equipment up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods on shoot days

### **Preferred**

* Consumer electronics, accessories or e-commerce brand experience
* Has grown a channel — brand or personal — with numbers to show for it
* Motion graphics and After Effects template work
* Advanced color grading and node-based workflows in DaVinci Resolve Studio
* Strobe and continuous lighting experience
* Still photography capability for social and e-commerce use
* Experience briefing creators or managing UGC and influencer deliverables
* Familiarity with paid social: cutting variants for testing and working alongside a media buyer
* Experience with livestream or shoppable video formats

* Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan.

* Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it.

**Demand execution and sales plays**

* Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement.

* Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar.

* Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process.

* Accountable for adoption and performance of the sales plays and cadences released into the region, and for revision or retirement of those that do not perform.

**Pipeline health and conversion**

* Accountable for a healthy and predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities for the regional sales organization, measured against defined coverage and quality standards.

* Uses data and analytics to track the performance of demand generation initiatives, and identifies the drivers of variance between plan and actual.

* Accountable for lead-to-deal conversion improvement in the Americas, including diagnosis of conversion loss by stage, source and segment, and the remediation plan.

* Tracks performance and progress of demand activity against pipeline health metrics, and reports status on a defined cadence.

**Cross-functional coordination and governance**

* Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and other functions to develop a coordinated and integrated demand plan that meets business goals.

* Hosts the regional Demand Board and associated planning activities to track progress and align the demand ecosystem on priorities, commitments and outcomes.

* Escalates to the Leader, Demand Orchestration where cross-functional commitments, resourcing or prioritization cannot be resolved in the Americas.

* Fosters a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and excellence across the demand ecosystem, and drives improvement of the processes and tools the ecosystem depends upon.

**Market insight and solution knowledge**

* Monitors and analyzes market trends, customer behaviors and the competitive landscape, and applies that analysis to demand planning and play design.

* Maintains a working understanding of areas of strength and weakness across the relevant solution portfolio, and reflects that understanding in targeting and messaging priorities.

* Partners with Product Marketing and Competitive Intelligence to keep demand activity current with positioning and competitive changes.

**Insight to leadership**

* Provides proactive insight to leadership on demand planning, forecasting and execution, including risks to pipeline coverage and the actions required.

* Represents the regional demand position in planning and review cycles, including quarterly business reviews and annual planning.

* Translates demand performance into the commercial implications leadership requires for decision-making.

### **Performance Measures**

* Pipeline coverage and quality against regional targets, by segment and solution.

* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-close conversion rates against baselines.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Lifecycle Marketing Specialist**

**North - Remote (US)**

***Let’s go North, together.***

Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.

**Job Summary:**

The Lifecycle Marketing Specialist owns the customer journey from first touch through renewal and expansion. This role is responsible for designing and executing email, in-app, and multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that transition contacts through the funnel—from lead to activated customer to advocate. Acting as the primary owner of the marketing automation platform (HubSpot), this position operates at the intersection of demand generation, product marketing, and analytics, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver relevant, timely, and measurable customer experiences.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, build, and optimize multi-channel lifecycle campaigns (email, in-app, SMS) across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, win-back, and expansion.
* Own segmentation and lifecycle stage definitions in HubSpot, ensuring clean handoffs between marketing, sales, and customer success.
* Build and maintain nurture tracks for MQLs, trials, and post-sale customers with clear conversion and engagement goals at each stage.
* Partner with Analytics/Ops to define and track core lifecycle metrics (activation rate, time-to-value, retention, expansion revenue) and report on campaign performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot data integrity issues across the lifecycle funnel (e.g., stage mismatches between HubSpot and CRM/Partner systems).

* Collaborate with Content and Design teams to produce lifecycle-specific creative assets (email copy, in-app messages, triggered content).

**What We Need From You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or CRM marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.
* Strong experience with HubSpot, including workflows, segmentation, and lifecycle stage management.
* Track record of building nurture programs that measurably drive key business metrics (pipeline, activation, retention, NRR).
* Experience in payments, fintech, or other regulated B2B industries is a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently pull and interpret data to drive campaign decisions.
* Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Success teams on lifecycle and handoff processes.
* Excellent written communication skills, with a capability to write compelling lifecycle copy or brief creators effectively.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a builder’s mindset focused on creating infrastructure rather than just executing existing campaigns.
* *Nice to Have:* Familiarity with SQL, BI tools (Looker, Tableau), product-led growth motions, and in-app messaging tools.

**What we offer:**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a *life well lived,* both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* 401(k) + Match
* Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
* Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
* Education Assistance
* Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

**Salary Range:** $60,980-$82,500

*Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.*

***Please note****: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.*

**Who we are:**

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.

**Let’s go North, together!** Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.

**At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: VP Marketing
jobs.description:
Paradigm Publishing Services is the publishing services division of De Gruyter Brill, a leading publisher in the humanities and beyond with a heritage going back to 1683. Paradigm focuses on supporting smaller publishers, societies, and university presses to ensure their digital visibility, financial sustainability, independence, and success.

**VP of Marketing**

The market for publishing, information, and knowledge-based services is changing fundamentally. AI, evolving customer expectations, new discovery behaviors, competitive pressure, and changing business models require organizations to rethink not only what they take to market, but how they go to market.
  
The VP Marketing at Paradigm will lead the development of a modern Go-to-Market (GTM) capability across Paradigm and connecting strategy, Product/Service, Marketing, Sales/Commercial, Editorial/Publishing, and customer-facing teams around shared priorities, customer needs, and measurable business outcomes.
  
The mandate is broader than traditional marketing: build the frameworks, operating model, governance, and enablement required to turn business strategy into coordinated market action—from identifying opportunities and defining propositions to commercializing offerings, enabling execution, measuring performance, and continuously improving.
  
As AI reshapes how customers discover, evaluate, consume, and purchase information and services, this role will help Paradigm build a GTM model that is customer-centered, commercially aligned, digitally enabled, measurable, and designed for continuous change.

* Build the Go-to-Market Strategy & Operating Model

  + Translate corporate and portfolio strategies into clear GTM priorities, audiences, value propositions, commercial motions, and execution plans.
  + Establish a common GTM language and methodology across functions and business units.
  + Create repeatable approaches that can be applied across publishing products, digital platforms, information services, and emerging offerings.

* Drive Commercial Alignment & Strategic Change

  + Identify gaps, dependencies, and disconnects across the customer journey and commercial funnel.
  + Establish clear ownership, accountability, decision-making, and cross-functional ways of working without requiring unnecessary organizational restructuring.
  + Ensure Marketing and GTM activity is connected to measurable business outcomes—including pipeline, revenue, adoption, retention, expansion, and customer value.
  + Challenge established ways of working constructively and bring an objective, outside-in perspective to organizational and commercial challenges.
  + Work effectively with senior leaders while maintaining strong relationships with functional teams responsible for execution.
  + Translate complex strategic problems into practical frameworks, priorities, and actions.
  + Lead through influence, creating alignment across teams that may not have previously operated as a coordinated GTM organization.
  + Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and a bias toward measurable progress.

* Lead GTM Strategy & Execution for Priority Initiatives
    
  + Develop integrated GTM strategies for major products, services, collections, platforms, launches, relaunches, and strategic growth opportunities.
  + Define target audiences, customer segments, buying groups, customer needs, positioning, value propositions, competitive differentiation, and desired customer actions.

  + Assess current GTM and marketing capabilities using structured maturity models and identify the highest-priority gaps and opportunities.

  + Customer and market intelligence

jobs.title: Director of Marketing

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Marketing Director is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing Burger Boat Company's marketing strategy in support of its business objectives, luxury brand positioning, sales growth, product strategy, and long-term market development.

Working closely with the Chief Sales & Marketing Officer, the Marketing Director serves as the day-to-day steward of the Burger brand, ensuring that its key brand attributes, craftsmanship, design, innovation, quality, and luxury positioning are consistently and effectively expressed across all customer and marketplace touchpoints.

The position provides strategic and operational leadership across brand management, marketing communications, digital marketing, content, public relations, events, customer experience, sales enablement, product launches, market intelligence, and external marketing resources. The Marketing Director will lead the day-to-day marketing function and establish the priorities, processes, standards, and performance measures necessary to build a disciplined and effective marketing organization.

The role works closely with Business Development, Product Development and Product Management, Operations, and Executive Leadership to translate business and product strategies into compelling market opportunities, sales tools, product launches, and customer experiences.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

Brand Stewardship & Brand Activation

* Serve as the primary day-to-day steward of the Burger Boat Company brand, ensuring consistency, distinction, and premium positioning across all customer and marketplace touchpoints.
* Develop and execute integrated brand strategies and marketing programs that strengthen Burger's position within the luxury marine marketplace.
* Translate Burger's brand trust attributes, positioning, value propositions, craftsmanship, design philosophy, product capabilities, and customer experience into compelling in-market brand narratives and market-facing communications.
* Establish and maintain brand standards for visual identity, messaging, content, photography, video, digital presence, collateral, events, and other external expressions of the brand.
* Lead brand activation across digital, social, public relations, advertising, events, boat shows, partnerships, and other appropriate channels.
* Direct the development of high-quality marketing content and collateral consistent with the standards expected of a luxury consumer brand.
* Monitor market trends, customer insights, competitive activity, and marketing performance to continually improve brand and marketing effectiveness.

Business Development & Sales Enablement

* Partner closely with the Chief Sales & Marketing Officer and Business Development leadership to align marketing strategy with sales objectives, target markets, customer segments, and business development priorities within appropriate segments in which we play (Luxury Yachts, Commercial, Repair and Refit and Government vessels).
* Develop marketing programs that build awareness, support relationship development, generate awareness and consideration of our brand to convert them to qualified opportunities, and strengthen the sales process.
* Lead development of sales presentations, product literature, digital experiences, videos, photography, case studies, customer stories, event materials, and other sales collateral.
* Ensure Business Development has the tools, content, market intelligence, and brand resources necessary to effectively communicate Burger's value proposition.
* Work with Business Development to identify market opportunities and develop targeted campaigns and customer experiences around strategic prospects, markets, and events.

Product Development, Product Management & Launch Leadership

* Work closely with Product Development and Product Management to translate product strategy into compelling positioning, product stories, go-to-market strategies, and customer experiences.
* Provide marketing leadership throughout product development to ensure consideration of target customers, competitive positioning, market opportunity, and brand strategy.
* Lead marketing plans for new products, product enhancements, and strategic product initiatives, including positioning, messaging, content, photography, video, digital experiences, sales collateral, public relations, events, and customer engagement.
* Partner with Product Management to create compelling product launch experiences for customers, prospects, brokers, media, and other key audiences.

jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.
* Show up at regio

Since 1906, the University of West Georgia (UWG) has been home to those who seek a transformative college experience. As Senior Marketing Manager at Teton Outfitters (a subsidiary of Polaris Inc.), you will lead global marketing strategy and execution for the KLIM and 509 brands, reporting directly to the General Manager. This role oversees the team focused on brand positioning, consumer engagement, communications, public relations, content strategy, athlete and ambassador programs, events, and integrated marketing campaigns across global markets. Working closely with Product, Sales, Consumer Direct, Creative, and Operations, you will align marketing initiatives with business objectives while maintaining each brand's distinct identity and market position. **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop the global marketing team of approx. four direct reports (seven total) by establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans while promoting accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute global marketing strategies for KLIM and 509 that strengthen brand positioning, support business objectives, and maintain consistent messaging and storytelling across markets and consumer touchpoints.
* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across owned and earned channels, including seasonal product launches, promotional initiatives, and consumer engagement programs that increase brand awareness, consideration, loyalty, and advocacy.
* Partner with Product, Sales, Consumer Direct, Creative, and Operations teams to align marketing priorities with product roadmaps, seasonal business objectives, and go-to-market strategies while maintaining clear functional accountability.

jobs.description:
Chervon is one of the world’s largest power tool and outdoor power equipment manufacturers with a rich history of innovation. Chervon’s commitment to build a better world by building better tools is evident in the products we manufacture and our green approach to manufacturing. We design, engineer and market power tools and outdoor power equipment within our brand portfolio- EGO, FLEX and FLEX and for other highly respected private brands. **Summary of Responsibilities**

The Channel Manager is responsible for driving profitable share growth across the entire market by managing the development of the channel harmonization strategies. This includes developing pricing and promotional strategies across channels that deliver top line sales and bottom-line profit with efficient utilization of working capital.

Brand Responsibility: EGO

Channel Responsibility: Key Channels including Home Centers, Hardware, Construction Supply, STAFDA, and E-Commerce.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

*National Promotions*

* Develop and execute the promotional strategy to drive demand and share gains for our national brands and minimize channel conflict.
* Develop a Pro Forma based approach to analyze promotional plans.
* Develop reporting to manage, track and analyze key data to measure promotional effectiveness and set KPIs.
* Attend product line reviews with major channel partners to strategize and present Chervon’s national and channel specific strategies.
* Analyze and track inventory, market share and competitive landscapes.

*Channel Promotions*

* Work with channel/customer to identify, develop, and implement channel/customer specific programs – channel promotions, strategic programs, events, etc.
* Support promotional plans to manage excess inventory at a customer level.
* Review Pro Forma financials, discuss channel conflicts and work through solutions with Sales, Brand and Product Development teams.

*Product Pricing Strategy*

* Determine market-based pricing strategies to stimulate sales to maximize share while managing profitability and channel harmonization.
* Align with Brand Managers and Product Management to ensure the right selection, positioning and pricing strategy for current products and new product launches at a SKU level.
* Work with the back-end Brand Business Management (BBM) team and senior leadership teams to create a Pro Forma reporting to analyze pricing scenarios.
* Monitor online marketplaces via third party vendor to protect the integrity of our brands in the digital space.
* Manage price changes as necessary driven by current business conditions from inflation to tariffs, from freight expense to competitive threats.
* Work with BBM team develop pricing files for all brands, including MSRPs; troubleshoot anomalies.
* Work with BBM team to maintain channel price files.
* Align with Sales teams and Back End Account Management (BEAM) teams in Nanjing, China on pricing direction, alignment and execution.

*Marketing Support*

* Align pricing and promotional strategies with Brand Managers.
* Working with the Brand Management teams, support the planning and marketing execution to drive the promotional success both online and in-store.

**Required Education and Experience**

* A bachelor's degree in business or equivalent and at least 5 years of proven success as a channel manager, account manager, or other related experience.
* Experience in building and successfully executing product pricing strategies within the retail environment
* Appreciates and thrives within an entrepreneurial environment
* Experience with sales performance metrics reporting and analytics
* Excellent communication skills
* Team management skills
* Strong analytical and organization skills
* Fluency in key business measures – sales, gross margin, etc.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects
* Salary Range: $115k to $145k base + bonus opportunity

**Travel**

This position requires up to 15% travel. International travel may be required on occasion.

Chervon North America operates in a casual and fun environment. Our North American headquarters is located one block from I-88 in a state-of-the-art LEED certified facility with high-end amenities such as a gourmet café, gym, outdoor terrace, landscaped patio, ergonomic height-adjustable desks, and open collaborative spaces. jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

**You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

**Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

#### **You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **SEO Specialist** to own off-page SEO and link acquisition for a fast-growing AI mental health and wellness platform. You will build a high-quality backlink profile through targeted outreach, digital PR, content partnerships, and relationship-building with publishers, journalists, bloggers, and site owners in the health, wellness, tech, and mental health spaces.

This is a link building-first role. Strong technical SEO knowledge is a plus, but the primary requirement is a proven track record of acquiring high-authority backlinks through outreach and relationship-building rather than automated tools or paid placements. You also need to be a confident communicator; link building at scale requires writing outreach that gets opened and replied to, and occasionally getting on a call to close a placement. If you have an excellent link building background, strong written English, and the communication confidence to represent a growing brand with authority and warmth, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

* You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
* **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy
* Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines
* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work inside a fast-growing AI wellness platform with a strong mission and a large and engaged user base
* High-ownership SEO role with direct impact on domain authority, organic visibility, and brand credibility

What You'll Work On

**Link Building and Outreach**

* Identify and prospect high-authority link opportunities across health, wellness, mental health, technology, and consumer app publications and websites
* Write and send personalized outreach emails to site owners, editors, journalists, and bloggers to secure editorial backlinks, guest posts, and content placements
* Build and maintain relationships with publishers and content partners for ongoing link acquisition
* Track outreach campaigns, response rates, and link placement outcomes with clear reporting
* Identify and pursue digital PR opportunities including expert quotes, data-driven content pitches, and resource page placements

**Link Profile Management**

* Audit the existing backlink profile and identify toxic or low-quality links for disavowal
* Monitor new and lost links and proactively recover high-value lost placements
* Maintain an organized link building pipeline and prospect database
* Report on link acquisition progress, domain authority growth, and key off-page SEO metrics

**Content and On-Page SEO Support**

* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to develop linkable assets including data reports, guides, and expert content designed to attract natural links
* Support on-page and technical SEO work as needed including keyword research, internal linking, and metadata optimization
* Stay current on algorithm updates, link building best practices, and changes in how Google evaluates backlink quality

What You Bring

* Proven track record of acquiring high-authority backlinks through manual outreach and relationship-building in a professional capacity
* Excellent link building background with experience across multiple industries or verticals
* Strong written English with the ability to write outreach that gets opened, read, and replied to
* Confident communicator who is comfortable representing the brand directly with publishers, editors, and site owners via email and occasionally on calls
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, or similar for prospecting, auditing, and tracking link performance
* Organized and systematic with the ability to manage a high-volume outreach pipeline without losing quality or follow-through
* Self-directed and results-oriented with a clear focus on link quality over link volume

Nice to Have

* Experience in health, wellness, mental health, or consumer app link building
* Background in digital PR including media outreach, expert commentary placements, and data-driven content pitches
* Familiarity with on-page and technical SEO alongside off-page expertise
* Experience using outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Hunter.io, or similar platforms

How to Apply

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short portfolio or examples** showing link building campaigns or placements you have personally owned including the sites targeted, the approach used, and the results achieved
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your link building experience, and walking through one outreach campaign you ran and how you approached it from prospecting through to placement

**Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you have an excellent link building background, write outreach that gets results, and want to own the off-page SEO strategy for a fast-growing AI wellness platform with a strong mission and a large user base, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

**About AIOS**
==============

**AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.**  
We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.  
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.  
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

* The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
* The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

* **Step 0 $100M/yr by end of 2025**: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
* **Step 1 $1B ARR by end of 2026**: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
* **Step 2 $10B ARR by end of 2028**: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
* **Step 3 $100B/yr by end of 2031**: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
* **Step 4 $1T/yr by end of 2035**: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.  
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

**Being a Senior Media Buyer at AIOS**
--------------------------------------

We are building a world-class team.

As Senior Media Buyer (Paid Search) at Aios, your mission is to unlock Google as a major growth channel, taking it from a small share of our paid mix today to a mature, scaled second engine that runs alongside Meta.

Google is our biggest under-tapped opportunity. Non-brand spend today is small relative to what the account can support, and our plan is to close the gap to Meta significantly across the year (>£1m/month).

Your job is to architect and drive that scale-up: growing spend profitably, without blowing out CAC, and without ever cutting corners on the strict ASA and CAP compliance rules that govern what we can say in ad copy (Rule 12.12 in particular).

Early on, you'll ramp into the accounts: current campaign structure, keyword strategy, tCPA dynamics, Search Abs Top IS, ad copy inside compliance constraints, feed setup on Shopping, and how each market behaves. As trust builds, you'll take on increasing ownership of the Google operation end-to-end.

This is not a strategy-only role. The work today is hands-on craft inside Google Ads. Over time, the ceiling is much higher: you'll lead the Google pod, take on EU markets as they launch (Germany, Netherlands, Portugal, Denmark, Sweden), and expand into adjacent channels as you earn the right.

Great performance means Google spend scales while CAC holds or improves, Search Abs Top IS climbs materially, tCPA campaigns get pushed to their real ceilings without breaking, new markets launch cleanly without hurting UK performance, compliance is never a firefight, and leadership trusts your forecasts more than their own intuition.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you'll work async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you're around for team calls (early PST).

You'll report directly to Dave Lane (Head of Performance).

You'll work most closely with:

* André Andrade - Creative Lead
* Michael McCann - Head of CRO
* Reinhardt Grobbelaar - Performance Associate

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Google Ads ownership: Over time, you operate the Google accounts day-to-day. UK is the core market and your priority today, with the rest of the EU on the cards this year. Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Demand Gen. Keyword research, match type strategy, negatives, ad copy, extensions, feed hygiene, landing page alignment, daily optimisation.
* Profit-aware scaling: You push spend up while keeping tCPA / CAC inside target bands. You understand how to grow Search Abs Top IS through budget, bidding, and quality score. You know how to scale a tCPA campaign when actual performance is running well ahead of target without blowing out CACs.
* Compliance mastery & account resilience: You operate cleanly under ASA / CAP and GPhC rules, particularly Rule 12.12 (POMs cannot be advertised to the public). You never reference prescription medicines, named drugs, or use words like "medication" in ad copy. You maintain and evolve our MCC and account structures to keep them resilient against the unique compliance challenges of GLP-1 advertising.
* Multi-geo orchestration: You run multiple country accounts in parallel without dropping balls - different keywords, localised ad copy, different match type strategies, different compliance realities, different reporting cuts. You build the systems that make multi-geo manageable as it grows.
* Ad copy, feed and landing page craft: You write ad copy that converts inside tight character limits and strict compliance rules. You treat Bolt like an e-commerce product on Google Shopping, owning the product feed, data quality, and the ad-to-LP handoff.
* Team building: As we add more buyers alongside you and underneath you, you hire, mentor, and lead the Google pod. You build the bench that this hire is the seed of.

**Need to have**
----------------

* Proven Google scale (hands-on): You've personally operated Google Ads accounts at £1M+/month spend for DTC ecom brands, in the platform yourself every day. Not "led a team that did it." Not "oversaw an agency that did it." ***You*** did it.

jobs.title: Platform Marketing Lead

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**About the Team**

The Revenue team drives Affirm's top-line growth through strategic partnerships, growth initiatives, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm's products.

Within the Revenue organization, Platform Growth Marketing acquires merchants through platforms and partners. We work with PSPs and ISVs to build joint go-to-market programs, activate partner ecosystems, and drive measurable pipeline, GMV, and revenue. As our partner portfolio grows, we're building reusable programs, assets, and measurement that help multiple partners go to market at once. The team works closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence.

**About the Role**  

We're looking for a Platform Marketing Lead to develop and execute merchant acquisition and activation programs through Affirm's platform and ISV channels.

You'll identify the right marketing channels for each opportunity, build integrated campaigns, and use performance data to improve results. You'll work directly with platform partners and cross-functional Affirm teams to turn merchant insights and business goals into programs that drive acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, and revenue.  

This is a hands-on role. You'll move between channel strategy, campaign development, partner collaboration, asset creation, execution, and measurement. Experience with platform or partner GTM is helpful, but we're primarily looking for a strong marketer who can learn a new ecosystem quickly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Launch integrated merchant acquisition and activation programs through priority platforms and ISVs.
* Select the right channel mix based on the audience, objective, funnel stage, and available evidence.
* Connect campaign activity to merchant acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, or revenue.
* Identify where performance is breaking down and recommend what to continue, change, or stop.
* Build messaging, campaign briefs, content, partner assets, and measurement plans.
* Develop strong working relationships with platform partners and internal teams.
* Turn successful campaigns into reusable playbooks, templates, and channel practices.

**What You'll Do**

* Own channel strategy and execution for a defined set of platform marketing programs.
* Develop integrated campaigns across owned, partner, lifecycle, events, sales-assisted, and paid channels as relevant.
* Build campaign briefs, content, partner toolkits, presentations, and performance recaps.
* Work with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence to move programs from idea to launch.
* Define campaign objectives, funnel stages, KPIs, attribution assumptions, and reporting requirements.
* Analyze performance and recommend where to invest, optimize, test, or stop.
* Learn the business models, audiences, and operating styles of different platform partners.
* Manage multiple programs while making clear priority and capacity tradeoffs.

**What We Look For**

* 6+ years of experience in integrated, channel, growth, lifecycle, demand generation, or product marketing.
* Experience selecting and managing multiple marketing channels against a defined business objective.
* A track record of measuring acquisition, conversion, activation, pipeline, revenue, or comparable commercial outcomes.

jobs.description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **Role Overview**

The Principal Product Manager (Marketing) exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning to accelerate global growth. In this high-impact role, you will lead the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models while enabling our global sales team with the tools, positioning, and competitive insights they need to win. Serving as a key evangelist, you will translate complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives and lead cross-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go-to-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership and scaling our market reach.

### **Employee Value Proposition (EVP)**

* **Purpose:** You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud’s open directory platform, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.
* **Growth:** You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, expand your influence across executive-level steering committees, and establish yourself as a premier industry speaker and evangelist.
* **Motivators:** Work autonomously at a high-velocity, tech-forward company where you can leverage cutting-edge AI tools to build processes and drive sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.

### **Major Performance Objectives**

Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

* **6-Month Integration & Asset Delivery:** Within the first 6 months, fully integrate into the marketing and product teams to deliver at least 3 high-value assets and incorporate JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.
* **Pricing & Packaging Strategy:** Within 9 months, analyze, optimize, and roll out an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).
* **Sales Enablement & Competitive Differentiation:** By month 12, equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.
* **Platform Evangelism & Thought Leadership:** Establish yourself as a core external speaker for JumpCloud within 12 months, delivering at least 4 public demos or presentations across multiple platform feature sets.
* **AI-Driven Process Optimization:** Within 12 months, build out and scale at least 2 AI-leveraged processes or tools to support the marketing team’s execution, while collaborating with the AI steering committee to deploy sales-driven assets that accelerate deal velocity.

### **Critical Subtasks:**

Supporting activities to achieve objectives:

* **Collaborate** with product management, sales, and executive leadership to audit and refine current pricing and packaging models.

* **Conduct** deep-dive competitive intelligence research to identify clear market differentiators and map out the competitive landscape.

* **Author** and deliver high-impact enablement assets (such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts) for the global sales team.

* **Partner** with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.

* **Master** the JumpCloud platform to effortlessly deliver comprehensive, multi-feature technical demos to customers, partners, and industry analysts.

* **Build and maintain** strong cross-functional relationships across the sales, product, and go-to-market (GTM) motions to ensure unified messaging.

* **Represent** JumpCloud as a speaker and thought leader at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.

### **Required Skills and Experience:**

* **Must-have functional skills:**

  + Product Marketing and Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy execution
  + Strategic pricing and packaging design for SaaS or platform technologies
  + Advanced sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and positioning asset creation
* **Preferred domain knowledge:**

  + Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, or Cloud Security
  + SaaS business models and developer/IT buyer personas
* **Tools or systems knowledge:**

  + Modern AI productivity tools and workflow automation platforms
  + Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM and marketing automation systems
* **Behavioral or power skills:**

  + Exceptional public speaking, storytelling, and evangelism capabilities
  + Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building across sales, product, and GTM teams
  + High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and process-building capability

###### **#LI-MH1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

jobs.title: Business Development Manager — Digital Marketing Agency | International Markets
jobs.description:
**Target Market:** International Clients, with a Primary Focus on the US Market

**About Strategyworks Consulting**

Strategyworks Consulting is a digital marketing and business growth consulting firm helping businesses strengthen their digital presence, generate qualified leads, and grow through strategic digital marketing.

We are expanding our international business and looking for an experienced Business Development Manager who can help us acquire new clients and build long-term business relationships across international markets.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Manager who can take ownership of international client acquisition—from identifying potential clients and initiating conversations to presenting our services, negotiating, and closing deals.

You will work directly with the founder to develop new business opportunities, convert prospects into paying clients, and contribute to the company's revenue growth.

**This is a sales-focused role. We are looking for someone who can not only generate leads but also actively participate in closing deals and winning clients.**

**Who Should Apply?**

We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on business development or sales experience in a digital marketing agency selling services to international clients, particularly in the US market.

You must have personally sold digital marketing agency services such as SEO, PPC, paid advertising, website development, social media marketing, or email marketing to international businesses.

Candidates whose experience is limited to IT services, software development, staffing, SaaS product sales, or selling digital marketing services exclusively in the Indian domestic market may not be a suitable fit.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Development:** Identify and approach potential international clients, particularly businesses in the US, that can benefit from our digital marketing services.
* **Lead Generation:** Generate business opportunities through LinkedIn, cold email, cold calling, referrals, networking, and other relevant channels.
* **Client Engagement:** Connect with business owners, CEOs, CMOs, marketing managers, and other decision-makers to understand their business needs and marketing challenges.
* **Sales & Deal Closure:** Present our services, recommend suitable solutions, handle objections, prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and actively close deals.
* **Client Acquisition:** Convert prospects into paying clients and develop long-term relationships that can generate recurring business.
* **Sales Pipeline:** Maintain a clear record of prospects, sales opportunities, follow-ups, and closed deals, with a focus on achieving agreed business development targets.
* **Market Development:** Identify promising industries, business segments, and opportunities to expand our international client base.

Required Experience & Skills

* 4–6 years of B2B business development or sales experience, preferably in a digital marketing agency.
* Proven experience selling digital marketing agency services to international clients.
* Experience working with or acquiring clients in the US market is strongly preferred.
* Good understanding of SEO, PPC, website development, social media marketing, paid advertising, and related digital marketing services.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently with international business owners and senior decision-makers.
* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach, CRM systems, and sales tools.
* A self-driven, commercially minded approach with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* A proven ability to convert sales opportunities into paying clients.

**Compensation & Incentives**

Compensation will be based on experience, working arrangement, and demonstrated ability to generate business.

The compensation structure may include a fixed component along with performance-based incentives and additional commissions for clients successfully acquired and deals closed.

Specific compensation and incentive terms will be discussed during the selection process.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work directly with the founder of a digital marketing and business growth consulting firm.
* Take ownership of international business development and client acquisition.
* Play an active role in sales negotiations and deal closure.
* Work remotely with an agreed full-time or part-time arrangement.
* Earn additional incentives linked to business you help generate.
* Contribute directly to the agency's growth in international markets.

How to Apply

**Do not apply through messages or comments.**

Please email your CV along with your answers to the screening questions below.

**Email Subject:** Application — Business Development Manager — International Markets

Pay: From ₹10,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in business development or sales for a digital marketing agency?

Work Location: Remote

**WAHLBURGERS: Where Real Eats Meet Real People.**

Born at the Wahlberg family kitchen table, we're all about great food, real connections, and genuine vibes. At Wahlburgers, we're not just serving up burgers; we're crafting a menu inspired by real, family dishes from the Wahlberg kitchen. Each dish is a nod to the flavors and memories that filled Mark, Donnie, and Paul's home growing up—traditions they've shared their whole lives. We bring craveable flavor, a menu with heart, and a whole lot of fun to keep our guests smiling and coming back for more. So, pull up a chair, bring your appetite, and join the Wahlburgers family for a good time, every time.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing Manager leads day-to-day marketing execution for Wahlburgers across corporate and franchise locations, including digital channels, WahlClub and CRM, gift cards, third-party delivery, and local store marketing (LSM). This role executes the Digital and WahlClub road maps, manages marketing calendars, and oversees monthly channel reporting.

Working directly with the VP of Marketing & PR, the Marketing Manager plays a hands-on role within a lean, high-output team. The ideal candidate plans ahead, brings data-driven recommendations, and translates brand strategy into marketing initiatives that drive sales at the store level.

**Key Performance Elements / Essential Functions**

**Job Responsibilities**

*The functions listed below are representative, but not necessarily exhaustive, of this position. Management may assign other functions not listed herein at its sole discretion.*

  

**Digital Road Map & Reporting**

* Execute and maintain phased, budgeted Digital and WahlClub Road Maps aligned with brand strategy and sales goals, with initiatives scheduled in advance.

* Own monthly channel KPI reporting, including performance insights and recommended actions.

* Develop digital and local store marketing (LSM) strategy and content for Annual Digital Road Map, new store opening (NSO), and QBU presentations.

**Website, SEO, Paid Media & Online Ordering**

* Manage wahlburgers.com and direct the digital agency on website performance, creative updates, and compliance, ensuring promotions and featured items remain

current.

* Lead search engine optimization (SEO) efforts with measurable performance goals.

* Optimize online menus and the ordering experience across Olo Ordering, Pay, Delivery, Catering, and Rails to increase add-on purchases and average check size.
